requirement.original: Main JS bundle 7.4MB served without gzip compression from nginx. nginx configuration in Dockerfile.webapp missing gzip_static and gzip directives.
requirement.clarified: Add gzip compression directives to the nginx config in Dockerfile.webapp to compress JS, CSS, HTML, JSON, and SVG responses.
requirement.what: Add nginx gzip compression to Dockerfile.webapp
requirement.why: 7.4MB uncompressed JS bundle causes slow page loads
success_criteria: JS bundle served with Content-Encoding: gzip header
constraints: Must use nginx:alpine base image capabilities only
Must not break existing routing/SPA fallback
Same Dockerfile used for both prod and dev images

root_cause_analysis.symptom: 7.4MB JS bundle served uncompressed, slow initial page loads
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Nginx configuration in Dockerfile.webapp contains no gzip directives. The default nginx:alpine image has gzip off by default when custom config replaces default.conf.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - gzip was never configured in the Dockerfile.webapp nginx config
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original Dockerfile.webapp focused on SPA routing, gzip was overlooked
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Without gzip, full uncompressed bundle is transferred on every page load

context.codebase_state: Dockerfile.webapp at 102 lines, 3-stage build. Nginx config at lines 54-96.

file_contents.Dockerfile.webapp:54-96: Nginx server block with location rules for SPA routing, no gzip directives

development_approach.strategy: Add gzip directives block inside the server {} block in the nginx config RUN command, before the first location block. Include: gzip on, gzip_comp_level 6, gzip_min_length 256, gzip_types with comprehensive list, gzip_vary on, gzip_proxied any, gzip_static on.
development_approach.validation_approach: Rebuild dev image, deploy, verify with curl -H 'Accept-Encoding: gzip' that Content-Encoding: gzip header is present on JS and HTML responses.

research_findings.reason: Standard nginx gzip configuration, well-known pattern
